Regulation 42 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015'.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Patel Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of the Allotment Committee of Board of Directors'.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Patel Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 28, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 147765820 : 844376117, i.e 147765820 Equity Shares for every 844376117 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 27 per share.
